planets.name: K2-100 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-100 with a 1.67-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-100 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-100. Its orbit and size follow Barragán et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
